summary: Bridgecrest Lending Auto Securitization Trust 2026-2 filed a prospectus (424B5) offering $580,590,000 in asset-backed notes secured by sub-prime auto loan receivables. The offering includes classes A-1 through D notes at par with coupons from 3.971% to 5.19% plus an unoffered Class E retained by the depositor. The transaction is a routine ABS shelf takedown with credit enhancement via overcollateralization, a reserve account, and subordination. This is a standard capital markets issuance, not a special situation. No special-situation event is present.
